items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: er muss innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung vorliegen (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG), schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Ordnungsamt Weserstadt – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The notice was formally served (förmliche Zustellung per Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO); page 2 shows the delivery stamp dated 06.09.2027 (Monday), which is the date of delivery for counting purposes — no 'deemed delivery' fiction applies to formal service. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week period begins 07.09.2027. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period in weeks ends on the day of the last week whose name matches the day of the triggering event (Monday, 06.09.2027); the second such Monday is 20.09.2027. That day is a regular working day in Bremen (no holiday), so no shift is needed. The Einspruch must reach the Ordnungsamt by this date.

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and costs (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft fällig.
items.computation: Rechtskraft (the decision becoming final) occurs, absent an Einspruch, with the expiry of the Einspruch period on 20.09.2027. Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of that event is not counted, so the two-week payment period starts 21.09.2027; per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends on the day of the second following week matching the name of the triggering day (Monday), i.e. 04.10.2027. That day is a normal working day in Bremen, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. This date assumes no Einspruch is filed; filing an Einspruch would stop Rechtskraft and this due date would not apply.

warnings: The payment due date (04.10.2027) is calculated on the assumption that no Einspruch is filed and the Bußgeldbescheid becomes final (rechtskräftig) on 20.09.2027; if an Einspruch is filed by the 20.09.2027 deadline, this payment date no longer applies.

The IBAN printed for payment (DE84 2905 0101 0003 6110 00) is a validly formatted German IBAN with a Bremen-area bank code; it is still worth confirming it matches the Ordnungsamt's known payment details before transferring money.
